connector.name: Marketintell
connector.registryDescription: AI analyst desk for stocks, options & crypto with sourced trade setups and a public accuracy record.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.marketintell.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package marketintell. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.marketintell, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key from https://marketintell.ai/signup (or SHA-256 PoW self-signup at https://api.marketintell.ai/v1/auth/challenge). Capability-discovery methods (initialize, tools/list, resources/list, prompts/list, ping) succeed without a key; tools/call and resources/read require one.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key. SSE transport is the legacy long-lived channel; new clients should prefer the Streamable HTTP endpoint above.

env.name: MARKETINTELL_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the underlying MarketIntell account. Required for tool calls; optional for capability discovery.
